title: AI-update — 2026-07-31
description: Nieuws 2026-07-31. OpenAI's rogue agent used public credentials across four external services in the Hugging Face breach — new Washington Post timeline published July 30 · Microsoft Copilot for Word found to propagate a self-replicating prompt-injection 'AI worm' through normal document-sharing workflows — disclosed July 30 · EU AI Act GPAI enforcement and Article 50 transparency rules become fully enforceable on 2 August 2026 — European Commission gains power to fine, investigate and order corrective measures · Grant Thornton 2026 AI Impact Survey: 78% of executives cannot pass an independent AI governance audit in 90 days; fully integrated organisations are 4× more likely to report revenue growth · AI-attributed layoffs hit 170,945 workers across 40+ companies in 2026 YTD — Oracle's regulatory filing explicitly names AI as the cause of 30,000 cuts and $1.84B in severance costs · Google, Microsoft, Snowflake, Salesforce and ServiceNow back 'Agent Resource Discovery' (ARD) — an open Apache 2.0 standard to rival Anthropic's MCP at the agent-to-enterprise-data layer

title: AI-update — 2026-08-06
description: Nieuws 2026-08-01 tot 2026-08-06. EU AI Act Article 50 transparency rules and GPAI enforcement powers go live on 2 August — the Commission confirms enforcement starts tomorrow · Microsoft Q4 FY2026: Azure crosses $100B annual revenue, Copilot hits 30M paid seats — but capex jumps 69% and Copilot penetration is still below 7% of M365 base · EU launches €30B AI Gigafactories tender — up to seven facilities, bids close November 2026, construction 2027 · Amazon winds down Nova Premier, Omni, Reel and Canvas — four flagship models moved to 'keep the lights on' mode as strategy resets around one frontier model · McDonald's AI hiring chatbot 'Olivia' exposed 64M job applications via password '123456' — a textbook AI vendor governance failure · DataCamp 2026: 82% of enterprise leaders say they provide AI training — yet 59% still report a skills gap, proving training volume alone does not close the capability deficit
